properties.headline: Tornado Warning issued August 10 at 1:49PM EDT until August 10 at 2:15PM EDT by NWS Baltimore MD/Washington DC
properties.description:
TORLWX

The National Weather Service in Sterling Virginia has issued a

* Tornado Warning for...
West central Allegany County in western Maryland...
Northeastern Garrett County in western Maryland...

* Until 215 PM EDT.

* At 149 PM EDT, a severe thunderstorm capable of producing a tornado
was located near Bittinger, moving east at 35 mph.

HAZARD...Tornado.

SOURCE...Radar indicated rotation.

IMPACT...For those in the direct path of a tornado touchdown,
flying debris will be dangerous to those caught without
shelter. Damage to roofs, siding, and windows may occur.
Mobile homes may be damaged or destroyed. Tree damage is
likely.

* This dangerous storm will be near...
Lonaconing around 155 PM EDT.

Other locations impacted by this tornadic thunderstorm include
Dogwood Flats, Cresaptown, Midland, Merrill, Reynolds, Big Run State
Park, Barton, Woodland, Midlothian, and Franklin.
properties.instruction:
TAKE COVER NOW! Move to a basement or an interior room on the lowest
floor of a sturdy building. Avoid windows. If you are outdoors, in a
mobile home, or in a vehicle, move to the closest substantial shelter
and protect yourself from flying debris.
